description: The pie chart titled “Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)” depicts how tokens are distributed across routing destinations in the FedHLM setting, and it contains three slices. The largest slice is labeled “LOCAL,” shown in dark green, and is annotated as approximately 94.5%. A smaller slice labeled “LLM,” shown in dark red, is annotated as about 3.9%. The smallest slice labeled “EDGE_P2P,” shown in blue, is annotated as about 1.6%. Percentage values are printed inside the slices, there is no separate legend, and none of the slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the slices appear arranged with the dominant LOCAL segment occupying most of the circle and the two small segments grouped together.
